verdict.rationale: The evidence includes no explicit no-training policy or opt-out control. The only related capability is self-hosting: you deploy and control the infrastructure that stores your sensitive AI data, keeping it in your own cloud account and region. This only indirectly limits vendor access to your data. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that customer data is not used for model training, a documented training opt-out setting, coverage of how Loop and other AI features handle data sent to model providers, and independent corroboration.
